outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic breast anatomy diagram and a classification table, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating circadian phenotypes and study aims, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic/cartoon depicting the experimental workflow for measuring circadian rhythms, not a plot of real data.
The traces shown are illustrative idealized line curves within a workflow schematic (not real averaged data), and line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E is an illustrative heatmap representing a correlation matrix; heatmaps are exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel F contains an illustrative example line plot of cell growth curves (schematic representation of the workflow), and line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel G contains an illustrative example dose-response line plot as part of the workflow schematic; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel H shows illustrative heatmap and mutation matrix icons representing the genomic analysis workflow; heatmaps are exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel I shows PCA and 3D scatter plots where individual data points (cell line samples) are directly displayed as dots, satisfying the requirement.
